Backend Developer

Fictional Employer One is building an internal scheduling system for imaginary field laboratories. We need a developer who enjoys taking ownership of reliable backend services.

Your responsibilities

  • Design and maintain APIs using PHP and Symfony.
  • Improve PostgreSQL queries and keep data migrations predictable.
  • Use automated tests and code reviews to maintain quality.
  • Collaborate with colleagues who build the web interface.

Your background

You have professional PHP experience, understand relational databases, and can explain design trade-offs. Docker experience is helpful but not mandatory.

What we offer

A permanent full-time position, dedicated learning time, and a collaborative engineering team.

Send an application through the careers form. Applications are reviewed continuously.
